$comment: Map of the test robot: a four-wheel-drive skid-steer, with no steering. It is the one sim/verify.ps1 uses to test the full loop. For a real swerve's map see sim/protocol/robot-map.example.json.
$comment_profile: vendor: the motors are CAN and the hardware loop goes through the glue over NT4. It is the profile actually in use; the hal profile (HALSim WebSocket) is not implemented yet.
$comment_sdf: Points at the SDF that implements this map. check.py uses it to verify that the order of the <plugin>'s <actuator>s matches the order of the list below: that order IS the index inside gz.msgs.Actuators.normalized, and if they diverge the robot gets its commands crossed without any error.
$comment_imu: The testbot has no IMU yet: the chassis declares no <sensor type="imu">. It gets added once the actuator loop is closed.
